thread:
Oliver H: FYI nightly canary flagged a p99 jump on small-model traffic, blocked rollout for now. seeing +70ms p99 on the kernel-selector path compared to yesterday.
Nidhi P: ugh. which job? link?
Oliver H: https://ci.internal/redwood/7492 — job `canary-performance-e2e` (compare 2026-03-17 -> 2026-03-18). perf-bot uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/1876543200/flamegraph.svg
Samir: quick thought — we merged the kernel selector heuristics tweak and a batching change yesterday (PRs #1456 and #1459). either could change codegen or selection thresholds.
Maria L: is KV cache involved? We changed eviction thresholds in abc123 earlier this week. Could be more cache churn => worse runtime.
oncall: incident note: canary rollouts paused until perf signoff.
Nidhi P: can we reproduce locally? if so we can git-bisect. I have a small reproducer for p99: `./tools/repro_perf.sh --model=gpt-small --seq=512 --batch=8 --iters=200` reproduces ~+60ms for me on devbox.
Oliver H: same repro here on a small GPU VM with current main. baseline at commit 7c9d8a0 is fine.
Samir: ok i'll run `git bisect`. prefer `git bisect run ./tools/perf-bisect-run.sh` which runs the repro and returns non-zero on regression. saves manual steps.
Nidhi P: perf-bisect-run.sh uses latency threshold 50ms by default, you can override with `PERF_THRESHOLD=30` for more sensitivity. Also set `KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1` to capture selection logs.
Samir: starting now. steps:
```
git checkout -b bisect/perf-kernel-1876543210
git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good 7c9d8a0
git bisect run ./tools/perf-bisect-run.sh --model=gpt-small --seq=512 --batch=8
```
perf-bot: bisect job registered: https://ci.internal/bisects/1876543210 (watch logs). artifact uploader will post flamegraphs for each candidate.
Maria L: while bisect runs, can someone try forcing old kernel choice? `export KERNEL_SELECTOR_FORCE=legacy` then run the repro, to confirm it's selector vs kernel codegen.
Oliver H: I tried `KERNEL_SELECTOR_FORCE=legacy` — p99 drops back ~55ms. so looks like the selector is picking a slower kernel variant.
Samir: git-bisect says culprit is commit `9b1f2d4` — the change set includes batching heuristic and a tiny allocator tweak. PR shows metrics but not this regression.
Nidhi P: open a draft rollback PR for `9b1f2d4`? or can we patch the selector to prefer legacy for short sequences (workaround)?
Maria L: patch would be faster. add a guard: if seq <= 512 && batch <= 8 prefer fallback kernel. we should add a unit perf-test to catch this.
Samir: i'll push a temporary revert branch and run canary with that.
Samir: pushed `revert/9b1f2d4-temp` and started canary build.
oncall: canary build queued: https://ci.internal/canary/1876543301
perf-bot: canary perf diff shows p99 back to baseline in revert branch — posting diff: https://artifacts.internal/1876543310/summary.txt :thumbsup:
Oliver H: great. please create a proper PR with tests+explain, and add a regression test to nightly.
Nidhi P: action items: Samir owns rollback PR + canary verification, Maria will author kernel-selector guard and unit perf test, Oliver will own postmortem and follow-up test coverage.
Maria L: i'll draft the PR with the guard and add the perf-test to `tests/perf/regressions/seq512_batch8.yaml`.
Samir: marking thread resolved if canary stays green for next 2 runs. thanks all. :raised_hands:
